questions.question: [Macronutrients] Q: Explain why saturated and unsaturated fats have different health effects.

questions.question: [Sensory Properties of Food] Q: Explain the difference between taste and flavour.
questions.correctAnswer: Taste is detected by taste buds on the tongue — there are only five basic tastes (sweet, salty, sour, bitter, umami). Flavour is a combination of taste AND aroma (detected by the olfactory receptors in the nose). Up to 80% of flavour perception comes from aroma released during chewing (retronasal).

questions.question: [Sensory Properties of Food] Q: Describe how a star diagram is used in sensory evaluation.
